property_summary: For any caller and any withdrawal amount performed by the owner to a callee that may revert, the reference contract always makes the contract balance decrease by the requested amount (it either succeeds or reverts), whereas the mutant that uses send can silently fail when the callee reverts, leaving address(c).balance unchanged and thus violating the balance-decrease rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace transfer to send (using return value) so withdraw no longer reverts on failure but may silently fail (affecting observed balance after call).
